name: @estate/operator-web
description: The ISOLATED OPERATOR ORIGIN (docs/03 TB7). A small node:http edge that redeems the cross-origin handoff, holds a __Host- session cookie scoped to this origin alone, and forwards the caller's own bearer to an exact allowlist — plus a FRAMEWORK-FREE browser client, so the surface that will run docs/03 §5.1's mandatory human review has no dependency tree and runs under a CSP with no unsafe-inline and enforced Trusted Types.
